# Main-Line Call Handling Log — 02/18/2026
Fairview Community Services | Front desk | 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.

## Directory
| Contact | Role | Extension |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Irene Sandoval | Accounts payable | 214 |
| Linh Sato | Office manager | 228 |
| Victor Rowland | Front desk clerk | 201 |

## Desk procedure
- Answer with "Fairview Community Services, this is Victor. How may I direct your call?"
- Ask for the caller's name, organization, callback number, intended contact, and a brief reason before transferring.
- If the contact is unavailable, ask whether the caller prefers voicemail or a message; do not promise a return-call time unless the contact provided one.
- Read back the callback number and repeat the message before ending the call.

## Call entries
- 9:12 a.m. — Irene Sandoval, accounts payable, called from Northline Paper about invoice 7714 for $486.20. Victor confirmed her name and callback number, then transferred her to Linh Sato at extension 241.
- 10:36 a.m. — A caller identifying himself as Omar Bell reported smoke and visible haze near the rear records room. Victor recorded the report and routed it to facilities. No callback number was provided.
- 1:48 p.m. — Linh Sato asked Victor to hold nonurgent vendor calls until 2:15 p.m. Victor placed the note beside the phone and resumed transfers at 2:15.
- 4:42 p.m. — Devon Price at Green County Transit requested a message for Linh about a meeting-room reservation for 02/20/2026 at 10:00 a.m. Victor read back the details and placed the message in Linh's inbox.

Messages with a stated deadline were marked "TIME-SENSITIVE" and delivered to the named contact immediately. No caller was told that a message had been delivered unless Victor had confirmed receipt.

errors.quote: transferred her to Linh Sato at extension 241.
errors.explanation: The directory lists Linh Sato at extension 228, not 241. The transfer destination contradicts the directory in this same log.
errors.fix: transferred her to Linh Sato at extension 228.

errors.quote: Victor recorded the report and routed it to facilities.
errors.explanation: The caller reported smoke and visible haze, indicating a possible active fire. The log records only routing to facilities and omits the necessary immediate emergency response: call 911 and alert the on-site responsible person.
errors.fix: Victor called 911 and alerted the on-site responsible person.
